lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of roughly vertical columns of high-luminance blobs posterior to the gill slits. The most prominent cluster consists of four vertical columns, with 3 to 4 circular spots per column, spaced relatively evenly in a grid-like formation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, particularly distinct in the mid-flank region where the blobs act as nodes within a vertical-striped matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible; one along the upper dorsal-lateral boundary and a second parallel ridge lower on the flank, both defined by a sharp intensity gradient between the upper highlight and lower shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin visible in the lower-left quadrant displays a high density of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more numerous per unit area than the blobs on the lateral flank.
